description: This file contains utility functions for verifying and logging the URL resolution for the /api/users endpoint within a frontend codebase, primarily used for development and debugging purposes. It interacts with configuration and auth token modules to construct URLs based on organization context.

methods.name: verifyUsersUrlResolution(organizationIdOverride = null)
methods.description: Constructs and logs the expected URL for the /api/users endpoint, verifying query parameters related to organization_id, and restores previous organization state if overridden.

methods.name: quickUsersResolutionSmoke()
methods.description: Helper that calls verifyUsersUrlResolution with a specific organization ID ('T0015') to log a sample URL resolution for testing or documentation.
